ns2:section.sectionText: During early registration, this class is restricted to majors specifically requiring the course. Restrictions will be removed during business hours on the morning of December 10, 2020. Students not already in those majors are welcome to register as soon as the restrictions have been removed. Contact mathadvising@illinois.edu if you have questions. Some seats are reserved for off-campus transfer students in majors requiring this course. Any remaining seats would be released on the Friday before spring classes begin. Note: attendance may be required at the scheduled meeting times.
